title: The Road to Highkeep
description: You have earned a name in the wold. The Regent's Courier marks the King's Road north for you and bids you present yourself at the Highkeep Roost — the capital's gate stands open to anyone the vale speaks well of. Follow the road; the roost-master will see you settled.

objectives.desc: Follow the King's Road to the Highkeep Roost
